Faroese Waffles

Faroese waffles are rich and sweet, and are mostly eaten for dessert or as a sweet snack between meals.

Preparation and cooking time: 30 mins

Serves: 4

75g/5 tbsp butter

150g/ 3/4 cup sugar

pinch of salt

3 eggs

275g/2 1/4 cups all purpose flour

2 tsp baking powder

1 tsp vanilla sugar

100ml/ 1/3 cup + 1 tbsp milk

melted butter for brushing

Combine the butter, sugar, and salt in a large bowl and beat well. Beat in the eggs, one by one. Sift the flour, baking powder and vanilla sugar into the bowl and beat well. Pour in the milk, little by little, beating all the time so that no lumps form.

Heat your waffle iron to proper working temperature and brush it very lightly with melted butter. Pour in a suitable amount of batter and cook until nice and golden. Repeat with the rest of the batter. Serve warm or cold.

Recipe for Vanilla Sugar:

Pour 200g/1 cup of sugar into a bowl. Split one large vanilla pod lengthwise and scrape the seeds out using the back of a knife. Add the seeds and the split pod to the sugar and mix well. Transfer the sugar into a clean glass jar with a tight fitting and leave at least overnight to infuse before using.
